name: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc.
industry: Capital Markets / Institutional & Advanced Retail Brokerage
description: Interactive Brokers is an electronic brokerage serving active traders, hedge funds, RIAs, and sophisticated retail investors. It is best known for industry-leading margin rates, which are priced as a benchmark rate (tracking SOFR / fed funds) plus a spread of 0.5%–1.5% depending on balance tier. IBKR Pro accounts access lower spreads; IBKR Lite accounts carry higher spreads but commission-free equity trades.
notes: USD margin rates as of May 2026: SOFR ~3.63%. IBKR Pro spread: ~1.5% on balances under $100K, declining to ~0.5% on very large balances. All-in rates historically 5.1%–5.8% for mid-range accounts. Rates are benchmark-linked and adjust with Fed policy in near real time, unlike Robinhood's fixed tiers.
